component.name: ProbeGallery
component.script:
sub init() m.top.focusable = true m.row = 0 m.cells = [m.top.findNode("hList"), m.top.findNode("vList")] m.top.observeFieldScoped("focusedChild", "onFocusedChildChange") end sub
sub onFocusedChildChange() fc = "invalid" if m.top.focusedChild <> invalid then fc = m.top.focusedChild.id print "PROBE|body focusedChild=" + fc + " hasFocus=" + m.top.hasFocus().toStr() if m.top.hasFocus() = true then focusCell(m.row) end sub
sub focusFirstCell() focusCell(0) end sub
sub focusCell(row as integer) m.row = row m.cells[row].setFocus(true) end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean if not press then return false if key = "up" and m.row > 0 print "PROBE|key up -> row " + (m.row - 1).toStr() focusCell(m.row - 1) dump("after-" + key) return true else if key = "down" and m.row < 1 print "PROBE|key down -> row " + (m.row + 1).toStr() focusCell(m.row + 1) dump("after-" + key) return true end if return false end function
sub dump(label as string) scene = m.top.getScene() line = "PROBE|state " + label for each id in ["h0", "h1", "h2", "v0", "v1", "v2"] line = line + " " + id + "=" + scene.findNode(id).hasFocus().toStr() end for print line end sub
